CALIFORNIA COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Lease Agreement made the 11 day of May 2025, by and between Jackie Gerhold [name of lessor], of 653 Woodside Road [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and Le mke Inc [name of lessee], of 1sz Letrtia Landing [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:

# 1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:

The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described 938 square feet (SF) of office Space located at 17803 Gorczany Throughway [street address], State of California.

# 2. TERM OF LEASE:

The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 10 month(s) commencing on the 11 day of May 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 11 day of March 2028. ("Initial Term")

# 3. BASE RENT:

The net monthly payment shall be 3400 dollars ($3400) per month. A security deposit of 2089 dollars ($2089) is required, payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month.

# 4. Options to Renew (Check one):

Lessee may not renew the Lease.

The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of __ renewal period(s) with each term being __ year(s) __ month(s) which may be exercised by giving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
